title: CSS Foundations
description: A hands-on beginner CSS course that teaches the cascade, selectors, color and typography, the box model, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, reusable CSS, and accessible visual states through a live browser preview.
audience: absolute beginners who know basic HTML
learners preparing for JavaScript and interactive web development
goals: Connect an external stylesheet to semantic HTML and write clear CSS rules
Use the cascade, inheritance, selectors, color, and typography intentionally
Control spacing, sizing, and visual structure with the box model
Build flexible page layouts with Flexbox and CSS Grid
Create responsive designs with relative units, minmax, and media queries
Use reusable CSS patterns, custom properties, and accessible interaction states
Style a complete responsive multi-page portfolio in the ZoeSkoul browser workspace

teachingStyle.tone: friendly, visual, practical, beginner-safe, and build-first

notes: Use fixedLanguage web and recipeType source_checks for CSS code_input exercises.
Use semantic HTML starter files and styles.css so exercises focus on CSS rather than prerequisite markup authoring.
Every technical topic should connect a CSS source change to a visible browser-preview result.
Use source checks that allow harmless whitespace and declaration-order differences whenever possible.
Do not require JavaScript, frameworks, preprocessors, npm, or terminal execution.
Topic and section counts are pedagogy-driven; never add filler topics to satisfy a quota.
